in_place_eye_edit.review: 独立复核者复读写后原图，全景可读温和地看向裴钱的脸，近眼尾仍轻微上扬，眼目在原尺寸下的变化很轻。

in_place_color_edit.request: 用户在溪边线稿检查通过后要求“开始下一步”，按既有制作顺序执行上色。
in_place_color_edit.prior_stage_record: record_r04.json 和 final_status_r04.json 为首次生成第六幅线稿时的历史记录，原位编辑后其历史文件指纹不再对应当前图。
in_place_color_edit.method: 沿原线稿对衣物、人物、道具及地形划分手工色区，使边缘就近贴合墨线，以底稿现有像素的明暗铺灰蓝、灰褐及日光淡彩。内存着色，现有 PNG 句柄 r+ 写回。远眼局部色差二次在同一原件上校正。
in_place_color_edit.palette: 陈灰蓝袍、米灰内衫、深护腕，灰棕腰绳与长穗、朱红金纹壶配暗红短绳；裴暗靛粗布、灰棕束腕和腰袋；朱暖灰褐旧袍、暖赭肤色和灰发；灰绿竹箱、草黄色编物、青灰溪水、暖米岸石、薄雾远山。
in_place_color_edit.scope_completion: 本次完成原位上色和写后复读，待用户审阅。未执行游戏对白框验证或接入。
limitations: 比旧溪边定稿更明亮，色面较平，远林与细绑绳的边缘偏软。
全景目光读作陈看向裴钱，瞳孔精确对视未验证。

verification.structure_preserved: 独立复核通过。三人的手足、水线、衣领、头颈、视线及道具位置连续，远眼在最终落盘图中眼线、眼白和邻近肤色可辨。
verification.palette_light: 独立复核通过。日光冷暖、三个衣色、朱红壶和两种绳色、竹箱与编物区分成立。
verification.persistence: 最终目标复读并解码成功，像素哈希与核对值一致。独立代理也从磁盘读取并核对最终 PNG 哈希。

in_place_realism_edit.request: 用户要求本场与 c2_01_rest_v1.png 的写实画风衔接，继续修改同一原件。

reference.role: 前一镜的光向、材质、线与色、景深及溪水表现

in_place_realism_edit.method: 沿原彩图的轮廓、姿势、衣料与环境分区取样前镜。按各块石面、水深、面颊与衣褶调整明暗，保留已修眼部的位置。分次以既有文件句柄写入 PNG 图像数据，刷新并从同一文件复读解码。

review.first: 第一遍独立复核指出脚踝肤色在水线截断、左上树冠剪边、局部石面受光及朱敛靴底接触需收尾。
review.final: 复核者重新打开最终原件。三处水线可见水光和浅倒影，左上树缘已碎开，前景石面明暗有弧度。两镜水色、树荫、石岸亮度可顺接，人物动作、视线与道具清楚，正常画幅未见严重拼接或新增肢体失真。
review.remaining: 人物面部与外缘较前镜稍平、略硬，左中景浅树丛有少量旧线，部分溪石仍有近似走向的纹理。

in_place_realism_edit.game_integration: 尚未接入本次修订，未进行游戏内对白遮挡及切镜实测。

in_place_clarity_edit.request: 用户反馈“画面比较模糊”。接在已完成的写实修订上，对同一原图做一次选择性提清。
in_place_clarity_edit.method: 只使用当前原图已有像素，在人物五官、发须、布料、近景编物及局部溪水、溪石的蒙版内，按笔触方向和对比度增强亮度细节。按原生尺寸校看，减弱本来已重的轮廓及竹篾的增强幅度，保护远山雾、右下虚草与高光暗部。

review.result: 独立复核从磁盘重新解码最终版本。三人眼眉、朱敛鬓发、草鞋与竹箱编纹更清楚，原尺寸未见明显白边或重影。左上天空和远山薄雾的两个独立样区像素摘要与写前一致。

attempts.prompt:
Create one finished wide 16:9 historical Chinese narrative painting. Return a single complete, edge-to-edge color illustration, target 1920×1080. Re-stage the supplied creek painting as the NEXT shot a few minutes later. It establishes the characters' visual identity, garments, props and the same quiet stream. Construct all three performers again from life studies in a markedly more naturalistic figurative painting style, with the lifelike presence of real people on a period-film set. This shot must read as three living people talking on a bank even at a small size.

The action has advanced. The little girl Pei Qian has put her needle away. Sitting at the lower left, she holds ONE of her small woven straw sandals loosely across her lap with both hands and looks up and right at Chen Ping'an as she answers him. Her shoulders turn a fraction toward him. She has a child's small frame, sun-touched skin and lively, knowing eyes; two practical high dark hair buns tied with muted cords; worn charcoal-indigo wrap jacket, trousers and a single small brown drawstring pouch at HER left hip, toward Chen. Her treated bare foot rests on dry stone and her other foot is low at the water's edge. Her other sandal lies near her own seat. No needle or medicine bottle in anyone's hands.

Chen, a slender Chinese man of about 20–22, sits nearest the center on a broad bank stone, trouser legs rolled, both bare feet visible THROUGH ankle-deep running water. Water refracts the feet and the waterline breaks across the ankles. Turn his face in three-quarter view down toward Pei's face. His eyes meet hers on the diagonal; a tiny smile in one corner of his mouth, attentive and unposed. One relaxed forearm on his knee, his other palm bears light weight on a dry stone beside him. Preserve his recognizable fairly straight eyebrows, quiet narrow eyes, lithe face, gathered black topknot and modest green jade pin passing through the knot with the curved head on his anatomical right. Weathered blue-grey cross-collar outer robe opening over warm off-white, dark forearm wraps on both arms, grey-brown braided waist cord with tassels, small red lacquer gourd with subdued gold details on a short dark red cord at his hip. His own pair of straw sandals is together on dry rock beside his seat.

Zhu Lian sits a step higher and farther back at the right, leaning forward a little with his forearms relaxed against his knees. He watches them with a wry, closed-mouth half smile. Lean, weathered Chinese man who looks 55–65, narrow alert eyes, a slightly crooked expression, naturally streaked greying hair tied with a plain wooden pin, modest moustache and a small tapered goatee. Old warm grey-brown overlapping cloth robe, plain flat cloth belt, loose charcoal trousers, worn cloth shoes resting firmly on dry ground. On the far right, distinctly separate from the man, Chen's unloaded open four-post green bamboo book basket sits on the bank, with a woven rain hat and spare travelling sandals tied to the side.

Art direction: the faces are the priority. Paint all three in one consistent tradition of observed human anatomy and restrained Chinese historical realism. Use human-sized irises partly covered by eyelids, lids that wrap around the eyeball, softly turning nose wings and philtrum, warm reflected light beneath a cheekbone, a chin shaped by bone and flesh rather than a pointed outline. Give Pei believable childhood proportions, a small but dimensional nose, natural eyelid folds, a trace of sun on her cheek, an animated expression without oversized shining eyes. Give Chen a real young adult's jaw, realistic eyelid thickness and a few loose hairs around the temples. Let Zhu's age show in the planes of his face, the creases below the eyes and uneven beard growth. Build features with continuous variations in light and temperature instead of graphic black contours, cel shading or flat skin fill. Hair has weight, softer flyaways and strands that wrap in the direction of each knot. Clothing has woven weight, compression at elbows and knees, and folds that cast narrow shadows onto the layer beneath. Keep skin matte, unsmoothed, faces distinct and sharply readable on the common conversational focal plane. Avoid an anime, manga, doll, 3D-game-character or cosmetic glamour appearance. The facial anatomy should be considerably more grounded and lifelike than a character design sheet.

Keep the creek and far mountains recognizable from the supplied painting: small flowing clear grey-green water, submerged pebbles and broken local reflections, mottled warm-grey rocks, amber grasses, deep cool tree shade behind the old man and a pale hazy cleft in the mountains at left. Soft directional light comes from upper left and lands on the three faces, sleeve folds and rock tops; warm skylight bounces from the stones into shadow. Eye-level with the seated trio, quiet observational framing with room around the figures, largish readable heads and visible foot contact, no awkward tangencies. The environment shares the same painterly surface, neither a blur filter nor a texture pasted into outlines. Muted earth and blue-grey palette, subtle warm skin, minute brush variation and believable atmospheric perspective. A single uninterrupted image of just these three people, no panels, labels, frame, subtitles, lettering, logos or watermarks.

face_line_study_20261101.prompt:
Reframe the central young Chinese man, Chen Ping'an, in reference 1 as ONE finished head-and-neck line drawing for the same creek shot. This is a pose-specific drawing of that existing character for an animator to inspect. Draw only Chen from the intact top of his topknot to the collarbones and the two beginnings of his overlapping robe collar. A single large portrait on plain white, square format; the face is large, with a little breathing room to image left. Nothing else in the frame. No text, arrows, diagrams, grid, callouts or multiple views.

Reference 1 is the actual shot. He is seated mostly toward the camera with his chest still in its original three-quarter orientation. The child Pei Qian has tilted her face upward at his left; from the viewer, her face is a long way to the LEFT of his eyes and only a little DOWN (about one-third as much down as across). He has just looked at her in the middle of listening, before speaking. It must read that he is making warm, alert visual contact with THIS specific person off the bottom left, not studying an object directly beneath him. Retain the camera and modest downward pitch of the scene. review.method: 先看独立头像，再对照母版与后镜并在内存把线稿缩到宽180px，使脸高约74px。
review.observed: 原尺寸和场景等脸高时，左向都清楚，近眼虹膜仍能与上睑区分，远眼缩短但保留眼白。鼻尖、口和下巴转向一致；表情安静。
review.limits: 俯角略弱，近眼眼轴偏平，向下凝视的落点还不够明确。脸相对母版略窄，下巴偏收。发髻顶部触及画框。

method.eyes: 固定眼睑开合和眼角。远眼虹膜与高光向左2.4、向下3.8源像素，近眼向左4、向下5.5源像素；可见部分裁在眼裂内。
